cohort: 402 singleton IVF pregnancies and 523 spontaneous singleton pregnancies at "Maichin Dom" University Hospital in Sofia, Bulgaria between January 2013 and December 2017
finding: Singleton pregnancies conceived through IVF had a significantly higher rate of breech presentation compared to spontaneous pregnancies.
mod_finding: There was no difference in the frequency of vaginal birth between IVF and spontaneous pregnancies when the fetus was in breech presentation.
